Lissandra|mid.identity: Magic damage control mage who specializes in shutting down assassins and engaging. Ice Shard (Q) slows in a line, Ring of Frost (W) roots everything around her, Glacial Path (E) launches a claw Lissandra can travel to, and Frozen Tomb (R) stuns an enemy or puts herself in stasis (healing and a slowing zone). Champions she kills briefly rise again as ice thralls (passive).
Lissandra|mid.playstyle: Engage and anti-dive mage. Lissandra beats melee assassins and fighters (Akali, Yasuo, Irelia, Yone) thanks to W and R, and engages teamfights with E + R. She struggles against long-range mages (Hwei, Xerath, Lux).
Lissandra|mid.early_game: Farm with Q (it passes through minions to hit your opponent behind them). Keep W for the enemy engage. Against long-range mages, farm and play around your jungler.
Lissandra|mid.level_1: Ice Shard (Q) first. Poke through minions.
Lissandra|mid.level_2: Ring of Frost (W). CC around you: against an assassin who engages you, it's a won trade.
Lissandra|mid.level_3: Glacial Path (E). Engage (E → travel → W → Q) or escape. Also keep it to get away from ganks.
Lissandra|mid.level_6: Frozen Tomb: a stun on an enemy or stasis on yourself. Engage combo: E → travel → R on the target → W → Q. Against an assassin, R on yourself to survive and slow.
power_spikes: Level 6: engage and anti-dive with R.
First completed item: burst and control.
Lissandra|mid.lane_plan: Farm with Q, keep W for engages. Push your wave and roam with E after 6: Lissandra is a very good roamer. The mid role quest (faster recall) makes these roams more profitable.
Lissandra|mid.trading: Short trade: Q through minions. All-in: E → travel → R → W → Q. Defense: W, then R on yourself. Give up on it against long-range mages who poke you.
threats: Ganks while your E is on cooldown.
mistakes: Using W too early and no longer being able to counter an engage.
Traveling to your claw in a dangerous position.
Using R on a tank instead of the carry.

matchup_notes.Zed: R on yourself cancels his ultimate; W when he reappears.
matchup_notes.Yasuo: W and R counter his engages: he can't reach you.
matchup_notes.Ahri: Keep W for the end of her ultimate.
matchup_notes.Hwei: He pokes you from far away: farm and roam.
matchup_notes.Xerath: He pokes you: engage with E + R once he's used his abilities.

Lissandra|mid.mid_game: Roams, engages and picks with E + R.
Lissandra|mid.late_game: Teamfight engage: E → R on the carry → W. Or protect your carries by countering divers.
Lissandra|mid.ahead: Roam, create picks and take objectives.
Lissandra|mid.behind: Farm, protect your carries and play for a decisive engage.
Lissandra|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to neutralize the enemy assassins and engage teamfights with E + R.
Lissandra|mid.final_tip: Against an assassin, keep W for their engage: that CC turns the whole fight.
